name: [Negative] Missing Customer Support
description: Customers are experiencing difficulty in getting help from the app due to unresponsive or non-existent customer care services. They are unable to resolve issues via automated chat services or human support, which leads to frustration and a poor overall experience.

name: [Negative] Customer Support Deficiency
description: Users consistently report an absence of reliable, responsive, and human‑centric customer support, citing lack of phone numbers, ineffective chatbots, and unhelpful ticketing, leading to unresolved issues and frustration.
